messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gpu-node-12 container restarted due to OOM during prefill (large context). Suspected long-prompt burst. Auto-scaling engaged.
ashley: seeing repeated SIGKILL in container logs, GPU memory reached 31.9GB then machine rebooted. stack: `llama_infer::prefill`
miguel: paging @oncall (jordan). can you grab it? sounds like long-window prefill hitting kvcache and not evicting.
jordan: oncall here, joining. any customer impact?
ashley: some 5xxs from hosted inference for model=rw-13b-extended on region=us-west1, roughly 1-2% of requests over last 3m. error rate spike on `/v1/generate` route.
sam: adding context: we had a traffic spike with a few very long prompts (>>100k tokens windows) from a partner POC. routing was to high-capacity pool without prefill trimming.
jordan: OK, immediate mitigation options?
miguel: short list: 1) toggle routing to fallback smaller-context variant (rw-13b-std) 2) enable aggressive kvcache eviction 3) temp drop max_context to 64k on gateway 4) block incoming requests matching >50k prompt length via WAF
ashley: I can flip kvcache eviction to aggressive on affected nodes. command: `kubectl -n runtime set env ds/serving KVCACHE_EVICT_POLICY=aggressive`
jordan: do it. sam, please start routing rule change to send new sessions to rw-13b-std. add gradual 30s drain to avoid client disruption.
sam: routing change applied (canary 10% -> 100%) :white_check_mark: 30s drain configured.
miguel: kvcache eviction toggled, logs show eviction events now, memory stable for 20s.
ashley: restarting container on gpu-node-12 to pick up env. `kubectl rollout restart ds/serving -n runtime`
ops-bot: Restart initiated by ashley. Pod serving-abc123 restarted on gpu-node-12.
jordan: monitoring. any sign of further restarts?
ashley: node stayed up, no new OOMs for 5m. 5xxs trending back down to baseline.
customer-success: flagged affected partner (#12345) — will coordinate an external update if we see persistent impact.
jordan: Good. follow-ups: - run an automated job to scan for >32k token requests and warn/ratelimit - add a canary prefill-trim option to runtime config - write a one-pager for SRE runbook for large-context OOMs
miguel: I'll open an incident ticket with metrics and stack traces, and attach the `dmesg` / CUDA OOM logs.
ashley: saving logs: `/var/log/serving/gpu-node-12/oom-1791445320.log` and uploading to incident ticket.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-1791445320. Assigned: eng-sre.
jordan: handing off to overnight oncall (miguel) in 15m. miguel, if it reappears, run the fallback routing and escalate to infra for node drain.
miguel: acknowledged. I'll post a customer impact summary in #customer-ops in 30m.
customer-success: thanks — please include duration and whether any requests were permanently lost.
jordan: closing this thread for realtime ops. will reopen if new OOMs appear. :thumbsup:
